answer: Agents register identities in the wharf state tree only after SGX/TPM remote attestation and a zero-knowledge attestation binds enclave code and hardware key to one execution domain; the terrace hash anchor and tundra consensus contract reject duplicate measurements. Forging requires compromising each certified enclave or provisioning distinct physical silicon continuously, while quadratic bonding O(N^2) and irreversible slashing make Sybil expansion economically prohibitive.
